$comment: Central allowlist for the brand-string validation check (scripts/check-banned-brand-strings.ts). Add new banned trademarks to `bannedStrings`. Add legitimate occurrences to `lineAllowlist` (preferred) or `fileAllowlist` (whole-file exemption). Source of truth: ORIGINALITY_REPORT.md rename map.
$bannedStringsComment: Each entry matches case-sensitively with strict boundaries (no adjacency to word chars, hyphens, underscores, slashes, colons). To catch a brand in multiple casings, add separate entries for `Pascal` and `UPPER` variants. The audit intentionally preserved lowercase URL slugs (e.g. /aegis/) so do NOT add lowercase variants.

$fileAllowlistComment: Whole-file exemptions. Use sparingly; prefer lineAllowlist. Globs are not supported — list explicit paths relative to repo root, or directory prefixes ending with '/'.
$lineAllowlistComment: Per-line exemptions. Each entry: { file, line, term, reason }. The check matches by exact file path + line number + matched term.
